text: Mubadala Investment Company is a state-owned enterprise wholly owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi; its own site describes the government of Abu Dhabi as its sole shareholder.
short: Wholly owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi

source.name: Mubadala: Board of Directors (Shareholder Support)
source.quote: Mubadala benefits from the long-term support of its sole shareholder, the government of Abu Dhabi.

additionalSources.name: SEC Schedule 13D filed by Mubadala Investment Company PJSC (Item 2, Recursion Pharmaceuticals)
additionalSources.quote: which is wholly owned by Mubadala, which is wholly owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi.
